name: taxcraft
description: US tax and accounting work for people whose situation outgrew consumer software but who still do the prep themselves: multiple entities, late and wrong K-1s, basis and carryforwards nobody is tracking, quarterly estimates guessed at rather than computed. Builds the workpapers a CPA would build — transaction-level books from raw statements, reconciled balance sheets, partner and shareholder basis, carryforward schedules, 1040-ES and corporate estimates — and shows the math with the Code section behind it. Covers 1040, 1065, 1120-S, 1120, disregarded SMLLCs, and corporate governance records. Does not file returns and is not tax advice.

interface.shortDescription: CPA-grade tax workpapers for people who do their own prep
interface.longDescription: For situations that outgrew consumer tax software: multiple entities, K-1s that arrive late and wrong, basis and carryforwards nobody is tracking, quarterly estimates guessed at rather than computed. It builds the workpapers a CPA would build — transaction-level books from raw statements and CSVs, reconciled balance sheets, partner and shareholder basis, capital-loss and NOL and passive and QBI carryforwards, 1040-ES and corporate estimates under the annualized income method — and shows the math with the Code section behind it. Covers 1040, 1065, 1120-S, 1120, disregarded SMLLCs, and corporate governance records. Each tax year's numbers come from a dated rules file, so a prior year never silently answers a current-year question. It does not file returns and it is not tax advice: estimates, workpapers, and drafts for a licensed CPA, EA, or attorney to verify.
defaultPrompt: What should my Q3 estimated payment be, and show the math
Reconcile last quarter's books from these bank statements
Track my partner basis and carryforwards across these K-1s
